series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_style_standard: Adult cinematic physically realistic 3D historical reconstruction & live-action 65mm location cinematography (ARRI Alexa 65, Panavision Primo primes, Kodak Vision3 500T grade: warm sandstone highlights, deep cerulean Summer Sea, lush emerald pastures, muted volcanic stone)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1r9uwSLfYkNeHxU9J48g0ZBF5Txwe1wgO, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Nine passed on the first pass — the wide-shot eye rule now keeps faces in profile, bowed or turned away at 24–35mm, so no iris colour was exposed to wash out, while the three frames that do present eyes (IMG0262, IMG0268, and the crop on IMG0263) all rendered saturated amethyst-violet first time. IMG0264 needed two rerenders: the first pass had a shaved-side undercut with a long braid and a second dark-clad man breaking the clan silhouette; the first rerender fixed the palette and removed cattle but reintroduced a known screen-actress likeness on two women; the second rerender de-identified every face and passed. Continuity flags carried forward: no shaved or undercut hair, no black or navy clothing, and no cattle in any later frame.

scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: camera travels alongside as they walk the wall in clean profile, crook and rawhide coil correct, motion smear in the near stone; no irises presented to lens. Volcanic cone and pasture beyond.

scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: 65mm compression, warm raking side light, wind crease detail; saturated deep indigo-violet irises confirmed at 600% crop on both eyes — unmistakeably purple, not blue.

scenes.visual_beat: Two-shot sharing bread on the wall, heads bent to the work
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: both heads angled down to the bread, no irises exposed, wattle fold and ewes behind, crook leaning on the wall; companionship without hierarchy.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide tableau of the whole clan at work across the homestead
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved after two rerenders: the whole clan in one frame across the homestead, every adult in the same undyed cream-and-charcoal palette with slate-grey or sheepskin over-garments and rawhide wraps, all hair uniformly silver-gold to ash-white and long, every head bowed to work or turned aside, faces plain and undistinctive. Livestock is long-wooled sheep only. First rerender was rejected for a screen-actress likeness on the woman carrying the infant and the wool-carder; the second de-identified all faces and removed a stray horned bovine.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation reveal — land pinched between the sea and the cones
scenes.editorial_treatment: Static 2.0s theatrical hold; clean cut on narration beat.
scenes.qc_note: Approved: narrow shelf between black cliffs and open ocean, eight conical slate roofs on one green spur, smoke, surf and outcrops; no roads, no fields, no harbour. Single worn sheep track threads the grass. The 'fertile prison' reads immediately.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: natural columnar basalt on the left, black volcanic shoulder on the right, backlit gap with green and sea beyond; both figures seen from behind at distance. No constructed tunnel, no rails, no lamps.

scenes.qc_note: Approved: weathered adult hand with rawhide wrist wrap and a small smooth child's hand on the same wooden shuttle, wool warp, clay bowl and hanks behind. Knuckle and finger shape carry the resemblance; no rings, no metal parts.
